definitions.explanation: Something good that is received; a benefit or advantage gained from someone or something.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}の{恩恵|おんけい}を{受|う}けている。
examples.english: We receive the blessings of nature.

examples.japanese: {科学|かがく}{技術|ぎじゅつ}の{恩恵|おんけい}に{与|あずか}っている。
{平和|へいわ}の{恩恵|おんけい}を{忘|わす}れてはいけない。
examples.english: We must not forget the blessings of peace.

notes:
USAGE: {恩恵|おんけい} often refers to benefits from abstract sources like nature, technology, or circumstances.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{恩恵|おんけい}を{受|う}ける (to receive blessings/benefits)
・{恩恵|おんけい}に{与|あずか}る (to benefit from - formal)
・{恩恵|おんけい}を{享受|きょうじゅ}する (to enjoy benefits - very formal)
・〜の{恩恵|おんけい} (the blessings of ~)

COMMON SOURCES:
・{自然|しぜん}の{恩恵|おんけい} (blessings of nature)
・{文明|ぶんめい}の{恩恵|おんけい} (benefits of civilization)
・{平和|へいわ}の{恩恵|おんけい} (blessings of peace)

RELATED:
・{恩|おん} - favor, kindness (from a person)
・{利益|りえき} - benefit, profit (more business-like)
